artworks.title: Sol (Sun)
artworks.description: This image portrays a celestial chariot being guided by a winged figure holding a radiant object. In the landscape below, there is a river, plains, hills, and an architectural feature. A falling figure, a scorpion, a geometric pattern border, and inscriptions including "SOL" and "XXXXIIII" are also present.

artworks.title: Marte (Mars)
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on a throne, holding a sword vertically in their right hand. The person sits upright with legs slightly apart and both feet resting on a surface. The facial features include a stern expression, prominent cheekbones, and a small, straight nose. The individual wears a helmet, and their hair is not visible. The person is dressed in detailed armor with ornate sleeves and pauldrons. A small dog lies beside one of the person's legs on the throne platform. The background depicts a decorative throne with architectural elements like columns. The scene is framed by a border with a striped pattern.

artworks.title: Iupiter (Jupiter)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a seated figure in a crown holding a scepter within an almond-shaped frame. The central figure is clothed in a flowing robe and wears a crown with elaborate detailing. The figure holds a scepter in his right hand, pointed downwards. Above the figure, an eagle with outspread wings perches on the apex of the frame. Below the central figure, another character is depicted sitting, with an expression of wonder, surrounded by several figures that appear to be soldiers lying on the ground. The lower part of the drawing includes an inscription, "IVPITER-XXXXVII". The artwork is rendered with delicate line work and an intricate pattern of stippling and hatching, creating depth and texture in the robes and other surfaces. The setting suggests a blend of heavenly and earthly realms.

artworks.title: Saturno (Saturn)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure holding a small child. The image shows a bearded figure wearing a helmet with ram horns. The figure is holding a small human-like figure near its mouth. The figure also holds a staff with a winged creature's head. Around the figure's feet, there are several small figures sitting in various poses. The image includes the inscription "SATVRNO XXXXVII" at the bottom. The style of the drawing is reminiscent of early Renaissance engravings.

artworks.title: Octava Spera (Eighth Sphere)
artworks.description: The image shows a standing angelic figure with wings, facing slightly upward with serene facial features. The person is wearing a flowing robe and holding a large sphere adorned with stars. The background is plain, and the image is bordered with a twisted rope design. At the bottom, the words "A. OCTAVA SPERA" are inscribed along with Roman numerals and numbering.

artworks.title: Primo Mobile (Prime Mover)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an angelic figure holding a circular object. The artwork depicts a celestial being with wings holding a large empty circle or sphere. The figure appears to be kneeling in mid-air, with flowing robes that drape around its form. The wings are detailed and feathered, and the being has long, wavy hair. The border around the drawing and the inscription "PRIMO MOBILE" along with Roman numerals suggest a connection to celestial themes or cosmological elements.

artworks.title: Lion
artworks.medium: black chalk, heightened with white, yellow chalk in the background
artworks.description: Drawn with black chalk with white highlights on beige paper, a male lion with a full, wavy mane looks out toward us on this nearly square drawing. He stands with his body angled so his rump is farther away, to our right, but his head faces us, his eyes looking slightly off to our right. His front paws are together and his back feet slightly separated with his tail curled loosely down between his legs. The bottoms of the lion’s feet are cropped by the edge of the paper. His mane touches the top edge and his haunches nearly reach the right edge of the paper, so he fills the sheet. White chalk highlights the lion’s left eye, nose, and closed lips. A few other touches of white appear on his mane and his left shoulder, on our right.

artworks.title: Jacques Callot
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a man in an engraved style. His head and shoulders are visible in profile facing right, with detailed facial features like a moustache, goatee, and wavy hair down to his neck. He wears a period jacket with a prominent collar. The portrait is set in an ornate frame with cherubs and decorative scrollwork. Cherubs hold items like a trumpet, feathers, and stars, and are positioned around the frame. A cherubic figure sits on a skull to the left, and stylized faces are at the bottom. The background has classical architectural elements and a large text panel underneath the bust in French. The composition is detailed in a Baroque style emphasizing its historical and decorative context.

artworks.title: Noble Woman with a Small Hat
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright. She is positioned facing slightly to the right, with her hands clasped in front of her. Her facial features are well-defined with a serene expression, and she has an elaborate hairstyle with a head covering that curves upwards. She is wearing an ornate gown with intricate patterns and lacework, along with a beaded necklace and pendant. The background includes architectural structures and figures engaged in various activities, creating a sense of depth and community.

artworks.title: Noble Man with Felt Hat, Bowing
artworks.description: The image shows a man in profile, appearing to be walking. He has long, wavy hair, a goatee, and is wearing a long coat while holding a circular object. The background features a townscape with buildings, a road, and people. The man's feet are visible in the foreground in an outdoor setting. The print is signed "Callot" in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Six Men and Women Beggars
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.7 × 25.5 cm (3 7/16 × 10 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows six figures in a landscape setting. Two standing figures on the left are holding objects, with a child between them. To their right, an older-looking woman in a hood is consuming from a bowl, while an elderly man sits holding a bowl. Another seated figure to the far right appears to be eating. A rustic architectural backdrop with an arched entranceway is visible in the background, along with distant figures and structures.

artworks.title: Eight Beggars
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.6 × 26 cm (3 3/8 × 10 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures dressed in long coats, hats, and with walking sticks, standing and walking in an outdoor setting. The scene features a group of figures with detailed textures, capturing fabric folds and expressions. There are varying postures among the figures, with some holding tall staffs while others seem to be in conversation or contemplation. The background reveals a sparse landscape with distant figures. The overall composition emphasizes the individuality of the figures while maintaining unity within the scene.

artworks.title: Men and Women Beggars
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.5 × 25.3 cm (3 3/8 × 9 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows seven individuals standing in a row, each holding a walking stick. They are dressed in long robes and draped in layers of cloth that cover them from neck to ankle. The first person on the left wears a tall hat and has a bushy beard. The second person has a turban-like head covering and a long cloak. The third person also wears a head covering and holds onto their stick with both hands. The fourth figure wears a simple cap. The fifth person is slightly bent forward, holding a walking stick and a rosary in one hand. The sixth person holds a begging bowl in one hand, draped in heavy clothing and a hood. The last person on the right is also clad in layers and holds a stick with a drooped demeanor. A small dog sits at the feet of the second individual from the left. In the background, the landscape features open fields with sparse vegetation and two distant figures walking, indicating a rural setting.

artworks.title: Catherine Kuttinger, Callot's Wife
artworks.description: The image shows a woman and a young girl standing side by side. The woman has short, wavy hair and a calm expression, wearing a long dress with puffed sleeves. Her hand is on the child's head while holding a small object. The child has curly hair, a dress with puffed sleeves and elaborate decoration, and a string of pearls. The background is plain with subtle texture.

artworks.title: Title Page for "Various Landscapes"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate cartouche with text and decorative elements. The central focus of the image is an elaborate cartouche that contains a dedication message. The text inside the cartouche reads "DIVERS PAISAGES Mis en lumiere par Iruel Dediez a Monseigneur LOVIS DE CREVANT Marquis Dhumieres. M. Callot inuente Avec privilege du Roy." Surrounding the text are elaborate decorative elements, including scrollwork and foliage motifs. Atop the cartouche is a crown resting on a crest-shaped emblem. The drawing is rendered in fine lines that accentuate the flowing, organic forms typical of this type of decorative artwork.

artworks.title: River Bank
artworks.description: The image shows a low angle view near the water's edge. Buildings are seen on the horizon across the water. The artwork features detailed linework, depicting trees, boats, and structures. The color scheme is mainly brown. Small boats are near the water with figures nearby. Further back, a path with buildings leads to a rustic structure partly hidden by trees. The scene depicts a tranquil yet bustling setting by the water.

artworks.title: Subtitle for "Various Landscapes"
artworks.description: The image shows a scene viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The space appears to be a grotto or cave with foliage and waterfalls. The horizon is not distinctly visible. The back of the space features cascading waterfalls around a central fountain or basin. The scene is detailed with delicate brushstrokes or etching lines showing the texture of rock formations and flowing water. The color palette is monochromatic with dark sepia tones against a lighter background. Figures, possibly from the 17th century, are engaged in activities like conversing and playing musical instruments in the foreground. The space extends into the distance with more waterfalls and vegetation, adding depth to the composition.

artworks.title: View of Nancy
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from a slightly elevated perspective. There is a vast plain with a fortified city in the distance. The horizon is in the middle with the city skyline filled with spires and towers. To the right, there is a large tree extending from the side. Beyond the field, there are faintly outlined hills. The art style features precise linework with cross-hatching for shading. The color palette is monochromatic with black ink on a light background. In the foreground, there are riders on horseback with dogs, engaged in a hunt.

artworks.title: Village Church
artworks.description: The image is a detailed etching of a countryside scene. A church is depicted to the right, with rolling hills beyond it. The horizon is low, emphasizing the vast sky. The etching uses fine lines to create bold and delicate details of the church, trees, and landscape. The color palette is monochromatic, contrasting dark strokes with a light background. In the distance, there is a body of water with a bridge and a small village on the horizon.

artworks.title: A Church
artworks.description: The image depicts a village setting viewed from the left side. The church and trees align horizontally near the center of the composition. The church stands slightly to the right of center, surrounded by trees. The style of the image is a detailed etching with precise lines and cross-hatching for shading and texture. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black on a beige canvas. Various figures are engaged in quiet activities in the foreground, with additional buildings and trees in the distance.

artworks.title: The Grain Weighers
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 19.6 × 21.1 cm (7 11/16 × 8 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a busy street full of activity, with multiple figures engaged in various tasks. The scene depicts a town street lined with buildings where numerous figures are engaged in communal or market activities. In the foreground, some individuals are seated or kneeling, seemingly interacting with the goods around them, such as barrels or baskets. Near the center, an elevated figure appears to address or observe the others. Animals, such as a dog and a donkey, are present. The background stretches into a street leading to a distant round building with columns. Beneath the image, there is an inscription written in Latin. The illustration features intricate detailing of clothing, architecture, and items.

artworks.title: Francesco de' Medici
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 21.4 × 15 cm (8 7/16 × 5 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image features a bust-length portrait of a person in profile, facing to the right. The individual is shown in a side view, capturing the head and upper torso. The person's facial features include a prominent nose and defined jawline. Their hair is curly and styled in a voluminous manner. They are wearing an ornate suit of armor with intricate designs, including a large collar and shoulder plates. The portrait is encased in an elaborately designed frame with scrollwork and decorative elements. Surrounding the frame are various objects, possibly symbolic weapons and banners. Above the frame is a ribbon with an inscription. The background within the main oval surrounding the portrait is dominated by fine lines.

artworks.title: The Possessed
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a gathering in a grand hall. The scene shows elaborately dressed figures in classical robes centered around a ceremonial event. The setting appears to be a grand interior space with columns and a high ceiling. An ornate altar is displayed in the background, with an emblem above. In the foreground, two figures are conversing amidst a crowd. A decorative frame surrounds the main scene, with text at the bottom. The composition is symmetrical, conveying a sense of order and importance. The drawing features meticulous line art and cross-hatching details common in historical draughtsmanship.
